claims.claim: Items placed inside the same bounded region are perceived as belonging together, even against other grouping cues, so labelled zones make category membership readable at a glance.
claims.construct: the Gestalt principle of common region (perceptual grouping)

grounding.helps: when an early product idea needs its problem, customer, and riskiest assumption on one page; the preset adds no claim beyond the zones
grounding.backfires: when filling every box feels like validation: a complete canvas is a set of guesses, not tested evidence
